description: This file defines a route component for displaying a monograph page in a Remix-based web application. It includes data loading, metadata generation, and rendering logic for monograph content, handling loading states and errors.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Generates meta tags for the monograph page based on fetched data.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches monograph data by ID, checks for spam, and returns data and metadata for rendering.

methods.name: MonographPost
methods.description: React component that renders the monograph page or a 404 message if not found.

methods.name: getMonographMetadata
methods.description: Extracts and formats metadata from a monograph object for SEO and display.

methods.name: extractFirstWords
methods.description: Removes HTML tags and extracts the first N words from HTML content.

methods.name: trimDescription
methods.description: Trims a string to a specified length, optionally collapsing whitespace, and adds ellipsis.

methods.name: addPeriod
methods.description: Ensures a string ends with an ellipsis, removing trailing non-alpha characters if necessary.
